item.name: /api/v2/SystemService/Outbox/Messages/:id
item.description: Returns one outbox message's payload-safe detail by id — its lifecycle status, the two classification axes (kind + message type), the attempt/ceiling budget, the recorded failure, the idempotency + correlation lineage, and the timestamps. Global-administrator only.

request.description: Returns one outbox message's payload-safe detail by id — its lifecycle status, the two classification axes (kind + message type), the attempt/ceiling budget, the recorded failure, the idempotency + correlation lineage, and the timestamps. Global-administrator only.

item.name: /api/v2/SystemService/Outbox/Messages/:id/Cancel
item.description: Stops a Pending or Failed message by operator decision, moving it to the terminal Cancelled state (deliberately distinct from DeadLettered so the dead-letter gauge stays honest). The reason is audit-critical. An in-flight (Processing) or already-terminal message is rejected. Global-administrator only.

request.description: Stops a Pending or Failed message by operator decision, moving it to the terminal Cancelled state (deliberately distinct from DeadLettered so the dead-letter gauge stays honest). The reason is audit-critical. An in-flight (Processing) or already-terminal message is rejected. Global-administrator only.

item.name: /api/v2/SystemService/Outbox/Messages/:id/DeadLetter
item.description: Manually moves a Processing or Failed message to the terminal DeadLettered state. The reason is audit-critical. Global-administrator only.

request.description: Manually moves a Processing or Failed message to the terminal DeadLettered state. The reason is audit-critical. Global-administrator only.

item.name: /api/v2/SystemService/Outbox/Messages/:id/Expedite
item.description: Pulls a Failed message's scheduled instant forward to now so the relay claims it on the next poll, bypassing the remaining backoff. Same row, retry budget untouched (the lighter-touch counterpart to Replay, which also clears the recorded error). Only a Failed message can be expedited. Global-administrator only.

request.description: Pulls a Failed message's scheduled instant forward to now so the relay claims it on the next poll, bypassing the remaining backoff. Same row, retry budget untouched (the lighter-touch counterpart to Replay, which also clears the recorded error). Only a Failed message can be expedited. Global-administrator only.

item.name: /api/v2/SystemService/Outbox/Messages/:id/ReleaseLease
item.description: Force-releases the lease on a message wedged in Processing (a crashed/hung relay) and returns it to the claimable Pending state, due now, so the next poll re-drives it. The in-flight attempt is NOT counted — a crash is not a business failure. The relay auto-reclaims a crashed row once its lease expires; this manual lever forces the release immediately. Only a Processing message can have its lease released. Global-administrator only.

request.description: Force-releases the lease on a message wedged in Processing (a crashed/hung relay) and returns it to the claimable Pending state, due now, so the next poll re-drives it. The in-flight attempt is NOT counted — a crash is not a business failure. The relay auto-reclaims a crashed row once its lease expires; this manual lever forces the release immediately. Only a Processing message can have its lease released. Global-administrator only.

item.name: /api/v2/SystemService/Outbox/Messages/:id/Replay
item.description: Requeues a DeadLettered or Failed message back to Pending so the relay re-drives it immediately (clearing the lease and recorded error, and bypassing the remaining backoff). The attempt budget is preserved — a replay grants one more pass, not a fresh budget. Replaying a message that is already Pending/Processing or is Succeeded/Cancelled is rejected. Global-administrator only.

item.name: Replay a dead-lettered or failed outbox message

request.description: Requeues a DeadLettered or Failed message back to Pending so the relay re-drives it immediately (clearing the lease and recorded error, and bypassing the remaining backoff). The attempt budget is preserved — a replay grants one more pass, not a fresh budget. Replaying a message that is already Pending/Processing or is Succeeded/Cancelled is rejected. Global-administrator only.

item.name: /api/v2/SystemService/Outbox/Messages/Count

item.name: /api/v2/SystemService/Inbox/Messages/:id/Replay
item.description: Replays a terminal message as a NEW processing generation over its immutable received evidence — the inbox's recovery lever (distinct from the outbox's same-row requeue). A selected replay-generation row is resolved back to its lineage root before replaying, so numbering stays global and collision-free; the new row is claimable at once with a fresh retry budget, and the root's evidence and budget are never mutated. Legal only from a terminal state whose authenticity passed. Returns the new generation's identity. The reason is audit-critical. Global-administrator only.
